- When the IP information used to log in from a device is left out during information transfer to NAVER (e.g., when logged in from the PC/macOS version of LINE) ## [Button: My Account Help] * Check login history * How to check login history * When the IP you logged in with is not recorded or the login IP information is different The login IP information provided in the Login management page shows the IP information given to the device (PC or phone) you logged in with. ​ The IP you logged in with may not be recorded for the following reasons: ​ - When the access to the device’s IP is limited if logged in via internet browser in an operating system (OS) of the device. - When the device’s IP information is lost while it was being transferred to NAVER due to a network provider/broadcast server issue. - When the IP information used to log in from a device is left out during information transfer to NAVER (e.g., when logged in from the PC/macOS version of LINE) ​ The IP information of a device you logged in with and the login IP information of login history may differ for the following reasons: ​ - When you use a smartphone in telecom company’s network environment - When an IP is not given to a smartphone but the public IP of a telecom company’s broadcast server is used - When a virtual IP is given since a device is connected to a network router ​ Please note that for the various reasons stated above, the IP that you are logged in with may not be recorded, or an IP different from the actual device’s IP may appear on the list of logins.-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 뚜냔냐 채널 - CHZZK (https://chzzk.naver.com/ba1714181cbb5d21cc870eba40a8b12a) citeturn47search3 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last month; What do hacking and account theft mean? Hacking and account theft have different definitions. ​ - Hacking: getting access to resources such as computer or network by bypassing or incapacitating the restriction measures in an abnormal manner ​ - Account theft: arbitrarily using someone else's account (ID or password) without legitimate access rights or beyond the permitted access rights 2. I would like to know more about the different types, cases, and penalties for hacking. Hacking can be categorized largely into 2 types. ​ 1) The following cases are subject to imprisonment not more than 3 years or a fine not exceeding 30 million KRW in accordance with Article 48 (1) and Article 72 of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection. - Infiltrating information communications networks without legitimate access rights using OS bugs or hacking tools due to system intrusion. - Infiltrating information communications networks by exceeding the legitimate access rights ​ 2) The following cases are subject to imprisonment not more than 5 years or a fine not exceeding 50 million KRW in accordance with Article 49 and Article 71 (11) of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection. - Acts that damage the information of others that are processed, stored or transmitted by the information communications network - Infringing, stealing, or disclosing the secrets of others ​ In addition to the aforementioned clauses, there are other penalties for hacking in criminal law. 3. What kinds of precautions should I take to prevent malicious code infection? ​ 1) Be aware of cases in which your devices can get infected with malicious codes included in impersonated emails. ​ When an email is sent under the guise of the National Police Agency or a financial institution, an attachment in the email will be opened to run a malicious code and your device will be infected with ransomware. Be careful when opening emails or attachments from unknown sources. ​ 2) Take precautions when using free Wi-Fi in public spaces. As much as it is convenient to use, free Wi-Fi provided in public places is indeed insecure. There are cases in which fake Wi-Fi is created by impersonating the correct name of Wi-Fi (SSID) and then inducing users to access to the fake Wi-Fi to inject malicious codes or steal personal information. Please refrain from accessing unknown public Wi-Fi, and make sure to check the correct name of Wi-Fi (SSID) before accessing a public Wi-Fi. ​ 3) Install antivirus software on your PC, and keep it updated regularly. Recent malicious codes can avoid being detected by interfering with the antivirus software’s updates. Boot your PC in safe mode (using network) and update your antivirus software, then detect malicious codes through a close examination. ​ In addition, if you are using a Wi-Fi router, keep the firmware of the router updated. Afterwards, set up the administrator ID and password, and set up the Wi-Fi password as well. ​ 4) Watch out for URLs sent to your smartphone. Smishing may automatically install a malicious spy app on your phone. ※ Spy app: an app that can collect, monitor, delete, and access data on a smartphone user’s calls, texts, and location information in real-time. ​ Even for SMS, messages on social media, or emails sent by your family and friends, if any of those messages include a URL, check to see if the address is safe before clicking it. You need to be extra careful when there is a popup message asking if you would like to install a program upon clicking it. Change the settings on your smartphone so that files without a clear origin will not be installed. Install at least 2 antivirus apps on your phone, and keep it up-to-date by updating it regularly. 우리는 이러한 요구사항을 준수하였습니다. 우리는 미국공인회계사회(AICPA)가 제정한 품질관리기준서(Statements on Quality Control Standards)와 국제감사인증기준위원회(International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board; IAASB)가 제정한 국제품질관리기준(International Standards on Quality Management)을 적용하고 있으며, 이에 따라 종합적인 품질관리체계를 유지하고 있습니다. **고유한계** 모든 내부통제체계는 인적 오류나 통제를 우회할 가능성 등으로 인해 그 효과성이 저하될 수 있는 고유 한계를 지니고 있습니다. 이러한 특성으로 인해 통제가 해당 트러스트 준거기준에 따라 회사의 서비스 책임과 시스템 요구사항이 달성되었다는 합리적인 확신을 제공하도록 항상 효과적으로 운영되지는 않을 수 있습니다. 또한, 통제의 효과성에 대한 현재의 평가를 미래의 기간으로 연장하는 것은 환경의 변화로 인해 회사의 통제가 효과적이지 않게 되거나, 정책 또는 절차를 준수하는 정도가 약화되는 위험을 수반합니다. **의견** 우리의 의견으로는 네이버웹툰이 설계하고 네이버클라우드가 운영하는 통제를 포함한 네이버웹툰의 NAVER WEBTOON 서비스 환경 내 통제가 해당 트러스트 서비스 준거기준에 따라 네이버웹툰의 서비스 책임과 시스템 요구사항이 달성되었다는 합리적인 확신을 제공할 수 있도록 2024년 1월 1일부터 2024년 12월 31일의 기간 동안 효과적이었다는 경영진의 주장은 중요성의 관점에서 공정하게 표시되어 있습니다.
